scope: One real cold-cache visitor per viewport, not60simultaneous renderers or physical phones

viewports.name: mobile
viewports.legacy_body_label_limit: primary_encoded_body_bytes and nested encoded_response_body_bytes are retained verbatim for reproducibility; read them as browser-reported encoded response sizes with unsplit headers.

privacy: No raw HAR, cookies, headers, credentials, request/response bodies or URL queries saved
cache_note: Fresh browser context; Playwright mutation interception disables the HTTP cache. This is conservative cold-cache traffic, not a warm-cache data-plan estimate.

byte_accounting.primary: Browser-reported encoded response size from Playwright. Legacy body-named fields may include unsplit HTTP headers because Chromium header size was reported as zero.
byte_accounting.cdp: Network.loadingFinished encodedDataLength is an independent browser-reported diagnostic; do not add to primary totals
byte_accounting.decoded: ResourceTiming decodedBodySize when exposed; cross-origin timing restrictions can make this unknown
byte_accounting.excluded: TLS overhead, retransmissions, unknown failed-request partial payloads and some persistent-connection traffic are not fully accounted.
byte_accounting.observed_header_size_limitation: Installed Playwright computes responseBodySize=CDP encodedDataLength-responseHeadersSize. With responseHeadersSize0, encoded header bytes may remain inside the legacy body field. Do not treat these figures as pure bodies or add headers again.
byte_accounting.preferred_label: Browser-reported encoded response/download size (headers unsplit); not exact data-plan/billing bytes

overlap_note.method_and_limit: Reconstruct last API stage from final run timestamp minus its fixed2s post-stage pause, wall duration and bootstrap duration. Infer observer readiness from finish minus measured loaded duration; screenshot/finalization overhead and rounded stage durations make this approximate. Do not claim the whole60.8s observer window occurred during the API soak.
